observations: Photo 0 shows a white console with a black and a white controller resting on top. The console has a circular vent on the top surface and an Xbox logo on the front right corner. A USB port and power button are visible on the front left.

Photo 1 is a closer top-down view of the same console and controllers, showing the black controller with a checkered D-pad and the white controller with standard buttons. The console's top surface has a textured vent pattern.
The console appears to be an Xbox Series S based on its compact white design, vent pattern, and logo placement.
No games, discs, or digital installation evidence are visible in either photo.
No power cable, HDMI cable, or other accessories are shown.
The seller claims the console has installed games, including Assassin’s Creed Valhalla, but no screen or storage evidence is provided.

read_from: photo 1 top surface vent pattern and overall shape
